problem_type: Prompt sections lose source identity and trust as information crosses the Agent context compiler
symptom: A loaded Skill, project asset, or fetched external fragment can reach an outbound prompt as plain text, so downstream receipts cannot show which source was untrusted.
direct_cause: The seven-layer PromptPipe stores one legacy trust value per section and has no structured source reference or AssetSourceEvidence link for fragments.
class_root: Every prompt fragment must carry a canonical source category, source reference, trust decision, and derived taint bit at the shared outbound compiler boundary.
affected_population: All Agent turns that load Skills or include project resources
All future web-fetched and external-MCP context fragments
All receipts and action gates that need to identify untrusted prompt inputs
entry_points: project asset and external fragment prompt inputs
internal_only_reason: The source taxonomy and propagation rules are the M4 contracts in the checked-in M-line rulings, Creative Resource Chain plan, and PromptPipe M3 implementation.
invariants: Every non-empty PromptSection exposes at least one structured provenance mark and retains it through budget truncation.
Skill content, web-fetched text, external MCP text, and non-cleared project assets are tainted and have untrusted trust.
Project asset provenance holds the exact AssetSourceEvidence object as the source-of-truth reference; M4 does not define a second license, fetchedAt, or usageStatus snapshot.
CompiledPrompt.taintedSourceRefs is derived from final retained sections and never hand-counted or independently persisted.
generality_proof: All current outbound Agent turns converge on compilePromptPipe, and every supported fragment category is normalized there before section construction; a future caller cannot bypass source marking by supplying a plain fragment without entering this compiler.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive trust and taint from the canonical source category and the reused AssetSourceEvidence usageStatus.
Attach provenance to all seven layers, preserve it across budget decisions, and derive the final tainted source projection.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The current runtime caller already converges on compilePromptPipe for every outbound turn; loaded Skill events are marked at the compiler boundary.
These helpers are characterization/compatibility utilities and do not send an outbound Agent request; the production outbound path is PromptPipe.

recurrence.reason: New prompt sources, Skill packages, connectors, browser imports, and MCP responses can all introduce the same plain-text provenance loss if they bypass the compiler metadata contract.
same_class_scan: Searched PromptPipe, agentChatV2, Skill load events, project asset source evidence, MCP skill reads, and context helper callers.
Checked the Creative Resource Chain M4 shared-point contract and reused AssetSourceEvidence instead of introducing another license or source snapshot.
Added PromptPipe class coverage for Skill, project_asset, and web_fetched propagation plus final tainted source derivation.

prevention.invariant: No outbound section is constructed without provenance; untrusted origins remain tainted after section assembly and budget trimming.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing optional fragment metadata falls back to an explicit host-derived mark; untrusted source categories are never upgraded by caller-supplied trust fields.
prevention.strategy: Normalize all supported source marks once, derive trust from source and AssetSourceEvidence usageStatus, then compute the receipt from final sections.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old section trust field remains as a derived compatibility projection; no second source snapshot or parallel compiler was added.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The invariant is implemented by Nomi's existing TypeScript PromptPipe and AssetSourceEvidence contracts; no third-party dependency controls it.

migration: Existing PromptPipe callers remain valid because legacy string fields receive explicit host/user fallback marks. New callers may opt into structured fragment parts without changing persisted project data.
residual_risks: Dangerous action interception and ledger/UI projection are intentionally left for slice C.
The AssetSourceEvidence v2 dependency is PR #388 and is not yet merged into origin/main.
